description: Crop-level frost sensitivity used by the frost advisory rule. Classes follow the common extension-service split of warm-season (frost-tender) and cool-season (frost-tolerant) vegetables. This table was drafted with AI assistance from general horticultural knowledge and has NOT yet been checked line by line against the cited publication; every row is 'needs_review' until the operator verifies it. 'unknown' means the rule will report insufficient data instead of guessing.
citation: Virginia Cooperative Extension, Vegetable Planting Guide and Recommended Planting Dates (publication 426-331), https://www.pubs.ext.vt.edu/

frost_sensitivity_values.tender: Damaged or killed by frost; warm-season crop.
frost_sensitivity_values.unknown: Not classified here (perennials vary by cultivar and zone; mixes vary by species).
